name: watch.process
description: Subscribe to one process's exit. Emits a single EVENT carrying the exit code when the process exits, then auto-cancels.

x-event-schema.description: Single EVENT emitted on process exit, then auto-cancellation. Carries the exit code.

exit_code.description: Process exit code (or value passed to TerminateProcess if killed).

x-implementations.name: register_wait_for_single_object
x-implementations.description: Win32 `OpenProcess(SYNCHRONIZE)` + `RegisterWaitForSingleObject` (NT 5+) — async exit notification on a thread-pool callback. Calls back to the agent's event-emitter when the process signals.

x-implementations.name: wait_thread
x-implementations.description: Dedicated thread + `WaitForSingleObject(hProcess, INFINITE)` legacy fallback for NT 4 / 9x where RegisterWaitForSingleObject is unavailable.

windows-modern.description: RegisterWaitForSingleObject for efficient async exit notification. Auto-cancels after the single event fires.

windows-classic.description: RegisterWaitForSingleObject on NT 5+; dedicated wait thread on NT 4 / 9x.
